advisoryExceptions.reason: GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c (npm advisory 1241202, medium) lists first_patched_version none for sprintf-js, and the latest sprintf-js is 1.1.3 (checked against the npm registry), so no release fixes it. kit pulls sprintf-js 1.0.3 in only through @microsoft/api-extractor 7.59.4 (the latest) -> @rushstack/ts-command-line 5.3.17 (the latest) -> argparse 1.0.10 -> sprintf-js. Three alternatives were rejected: no patched sprintf-js exists; a TypeScript compiler API would reimplement the canonical references and ae-forgotten-export detection of API Extractor (P14); an argparse 2.0.1 override breaks 'api-extractor --help', which lint-ts runs. make lint-ts runs that command with fixed arguments only, and no input of a user reaches sprintf-js
advisoryExceptions.removalCondition: a patched sprintf-js (a version that fixes GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c), or an api-extractor release without argparse 1.x; make dependency-review then reports the exception as stale
